name: matiks-reward-engine
description: Player Reward Rule Engine — event-driven, config-driven, idempotent

scripts.dev: concurrently --prefix-colors "blue,green" --names "backend,frontend" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix frontend
